reviews.author: Kyuna Min
reviews.text:
I visited the Gangnam Samsung Store for the first time yesterday. There were so many people that it was a bit hectic, but I was impressed by the staff's very friendly and thorough guidance even in such a busy situation.

In particular, I was looking for a new cell phone, and I had a lot of trouble deciding between the model I wanted and the performance I needed. You were very helpful by accurately understanding the situation and providing really useful information based on your own experience. I was grateful that they did not force me to recommend a product, but rather guided me to comfortably choose the model that best suited me.

Although it took quite some time as the decision was not easy, I was able to complete the purchase in a good mood thanks to the staff who waited calmly and patiently helped me without losing a smile until the end. I was very reassured as they thoroughly helped me with everything from purchasing a new phone to sharing data and selling my existing phone.

Additionally, while participating in an event held at the Samsung Store, explanations were kindly given in English for children who were not good at Korean, and thanks to the creative program, the whole family was able to make fun memories. My son was very satisfied with his new cell phone, and the various free gifts and warm hospitality made his shopping experience even more enjoyable.

All the staff were very kind, but I would like to especially praise staff member Jeon Yu-jin, who was the most attentive and kind in helping me. Thanks to you, it was a fun and satisfying shopping experience!

reviews.author: Jae-shin Byun (Jju strikeout rate)
reviews.text: They said they would give me a gift certificate, so I didn't hesitate to go the distance to pick it up in person. It seemed friendly, but it was a bit... They said there were no cases in stock and it's been a year since the S25 Plus came out, but in a situation where there is no next model (26), it's the latest model, but it's been a year since it came out, so I didn't have many cases... It's a bit unfair to say that they don't have many cases because it's been a year since they came out. Around 15,000 won...

reviews.author: J Kim
reviews.text: It's nice to be able to experience a variety of Galaxy products. It is good to visit during the day on a weekday as it is quiet and you can receive consultation for a long time. However, the space on each floor is somewhat narrow, so it is inconvenient to have to use the stairs or elevator to get around. It's nice to have a cafe and event space on the 3rd floor, but since it's a stand-up type, it's hard for people who can't sit without a backrest to sit for long, and it feels a little cluttered as a cafe space. The view is good, but since it is on the 3rd floor, the view is just like Gangnam Street, and the exhibition and experience space on the 2nd floor is mainly focused on Galaxy products. Good for purchasing accessories.
